docs.title: Least privilege for stack credentials
docs.body:
# Least privilege for stack credentials

Each stack gets its own credential, scoped to one service and one purpose. A test deployment never reuses a production credential.

See [[concepts/secret-files]].

docs.title: Secret files
docs.body:
# Secret files

Compose mounts a secret file at `/run/secrets/<name>`. The process reads it once. The value never enters an environment variable.

docs.title: Storage node
docs.body:
# Storage node

A small server with two mirrored disks. It holds the backups of the lab.

docs.title: Three tiers of agent memory
docs.body:
# Three tiers of agent memory

| Tier | Example | Lifetime |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Session | the open conversation | minutes |
| Working | a project brief | weeks |
| Long term | a preference | months |

A reader must know which tier a fact comes from.
